findings.title: maybeCompressImage is not a guaranteed no-op for the signature PNG; it can re-encode to JPEG and rename .png -> .jpg on wide/high-DPI viewports
findings.where: design.md 'Capture / upload UX (chosen)' + upload.ts matrix row; vs apps/web/src/lib/upload.ts maybeCompressImage
findings.fix: Bypass maybeCompressImage for signatures or clamp canvas backing-store longest edge to <=1600 (canvas.width = Math.min(rect.width*dpr, 1600)) so the PNG stays on the unchanged path; otherwise correct the design text to accept a signature.jpg result.

findings.title: New QuestionField state (sigRef, sigEmpty) must be declared as unconditional hooks; design does not specify placement or sigEmpty init, risking a Rules-of-Hooks violation
findings.where: design.md 'Capture / upload UX (chosen)' Public-form lifecycle steps 1-3 + 're-sign' edge case; vs apps/web/src/pages/PublicFormPage.tsx QuestionField (unconditional upload-state hooks)
findings.fix: State: declare const sigRef = useRef<SignaturePadHandle>(null) and const [sigEmpty, setSigEmpty] = useState(true) at the top of QuestionField alongside the existing unconditional upload hooks (NOT inside the SIGNATURE branch); derive uploadedUrl exactly as the FILE_UPLOAD branch (typeof value === 'string' && value.startsWith('http')).

findings.title: Approximate line numbers for the editor FILE_UPLOAD settings panel have drifted
findings.where: design.md matrix/validation; vs FormEditorPage.tsx (settings panel ~1666, type-change handler ~1448)
findings.fix: Update the matrix references: FILE_UPLOAD settings panel ~line 1666, type-change handler ~line 1448.

findings.title: SignaturePad border styling leaves solid-vs-dashed as an unresolved 'optional'
findings.fix: Pick one: keep 2px dashed #cbd5e1 always; do not switch to solid on draw.

findings.title: signature_pad v5 event API stated inconsistently (addEventListener for subscribe but off() for teardown)
findings.where: design.md 'signature_pad v5 integration' + 'Internal wiring' + verify-at-install list
findings.fix: Use a matched pair confirmed against the installed v5 types: addEventListener/removeEventListener OR on/off; do not mix addEventListener with off().
